ItemID: unavailable; Title: Duets: Re-Working The Catalogue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A collection of reworked duets does not grab me enough to explore today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I enjoyed exploring Old Sock, so this relaxed blues-rooted direction is my first choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and roots rock than a polished vocal album right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: An Acoustic Evening At The Vienna Opera House; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Acoustic blues sounds appealing, but I am only picking one album this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: In My Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its soul and blues direction fits my interest in Memphis, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Live at the Cellar Door; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: An intimate roots-oriented live recording appeals, though it is not my first pick today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: A Day In Nashville; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues direction interests me, but I do not feel a strong enough pull to choose another album.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Don't Explain; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Soulful blues fits my current listening mood, but I would leave this for another visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: An Anthology; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to investigate a broad collection today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Gary Clark Jr. Live; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Electric blues guitar connects with my interest in People, Hell & Angels, but I prefer my first choice this time.
